# yanga-project

```{toctree}
:hidden:
tools
logbook
```

{.lede}
A software product line engineering platform. Tools, workflows and trainings for building one product line into many variants on many platforms.

<div class="notes"><b>NOTES</b>
<ol>
<li>One configuration in, every variant out.</li>
</ol>
</div>

# Tools

{.lede}
The parts the platform is built from. One holds the product line concepts, the other turns them into builds.

<div class="details">
<section class="detail">
<span class="tag">DETAIL A · ITEM 1</span>
<h2>yanga-core</h2>
<p>The product line concepts: variants, platforms, components and feature models. Independent of any build system.</p>
<div class="links"><a href="https://github.com/yanga-project/yanga-core">GitHub</a><a href="https://pypi.org/project/yanga-core/">PyPI</a></div>
</section>
<section class="detail">
<span class="tag">DETAIL B · ITEM 2</span>
<h2>yanga</h2>
<p>The build system backend for C/C++ product lines, built on yanga-core. Generates and runs the build for every variant and platform.</p>
<div class="links"><a href="https://github.com/yanga-project/yanga">GitHub</a><a href="https://pypi.org/project/yanga/">PyPI</a><a href="https://yanga.readthedocs.io">Docs</a></div>
</section>
</div>

{.lede}
Notes from building the platform, newest first.

:glob:

logbook/*

# 2026-10-21 · Why the site looks like a technical drawing

A product line is engineered, so the site is drawn like an engineering drawing set. Each page is a sheet with a number, and the header is the sheet index.

## Taken from standards

- The colours are RAL 7035, 7016 and 9016, the greys and white of industrial control cabinets.
- The font is osifont, lettering after ISO 3098.
- Lines come in two widths, thick and thin, as in ISO 128.

## Adding a sheet

A new page is a Markdown file plus one line in `conf.py`:

```python
"sheets": [
    ("index", "Overview"),
    ("tools", "Tools"),
    ("logbook", "Logbook"),
],
```


# 2026-10-20 · yanga-project.dev is online

The yanga-project now has its own address. Until today, everything about yanga lived in the repositories and in talks on my personal site.

This site is the place for the platform as a whole: the tools, how to work with them, trainings and examples. It starts small, with an overview and the tools sheet, and grows one sheet at a time.
